info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Payment Details API
info.description: The Loan Payment Details API allows consumers to access comprehensive information about specific payments associated with a given loan. By providing a loan ID and a payment ID, users can retrieve detailed payment data, including amounts, due dates, and status. This API is essential for financial institutions, loan servicers, and customers who need to monitor and manage loan payments efficiently. Typical use cases include auditing payment history and providing customer support related to loan transactions.

get.summary: Retrieve payment details for a specific loan.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information about a specific payment made towards a loan. You can use the loan ID and payment ID to access specific transaction data, including amount, date, and status.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving payment information associated with the specified loan and payment IDs. The JSON payload should adhere to the defined schema, which contains all necessary parameters for the operation.

GetLoanPaymentDetailsRequest.description: This schema represents the JSON request body for retrieving payment operation details related to a specific loan.

GetLoanPaymentDetailsResponse_200.title: Loan Payment Response

amount.description: The total amount involved in the payment.

paymentDate.description: The date when the payment was made.

valueDate.description: The date value of the payment as per accounting rules.

paymentMethod.description: The method used for the payment (e.g., credit card, bank transfer).

sourceAccountNumber.description: The account number from which the payment was made.

externalReference.description: An external reference related to the payment.

allocationStrategy.description: The strategy used for allocating the payment.

targetInstallmentNumbers.description: The installment numbers to which this payment is allocated.

manualAllocation.description: Details of any manual allocation of the payment.

narrative.description: A brief description or narrative of the payment.

status.description: The status of the payment (e.g., Pending, Completed).

allocation.description: Details of how the payment amount was allocated.

transactionReference.description: The transaction reference for tracking purposes.

postedAt.description: The date and time when the payment was posted.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the payment.
